_documentation.relies_on: Loaded by a simulation or experiment configuration; packaged defaults fill only omitted optional simulation controls.
_documentation.run_command: Not run directly; reference this filename from a simulation or tool configuration.
_documentation.authority: Values in this file are authoritative for its runner. A sweep value overrides the corresponding base-simulation value only for that named case; effective values are recorded in summary.json.

fields.name: Human-readable identifier.
fields.Tc: Critical temperature above which equilibrium superconductivity vanishes.
fields.coherence_length: Superconducting coherence length used for spatial TDGL scaling.
fields.penetration_depth: London penetration depth used for magnetic scaling and validity checks.
fields.tdgl_u: Material default for the dimensionless TDGL relaxation constant.
fields.heat_capacity: Volumetric heat capacity used by thermal evolution.
